_about: A probe, never published: gpt-oss-20b on the flagship's GPU server with its release's arguments, to see whether the server starts it and answers the flagship's load with them (gpt-oss speaks the harmony format and its reasoning cannot be turned off, while the release starts the server with --reasoning off), and how much of the card and of the environment's memory it takes. One unit at the card's default limit on all cores. Paths are the environment's (ADR 3): line 2's files are carried in under /srv/line2 and listed in /srv/line2/SHA256SUMS, this repository at /srv/line2/repo with its own models.lock; the flagship's release is the one line 1 carried in, read only. Nothing under /srv/line1 changes for it.
accelerator: GPU, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, a workstation
